name: Dot Matrix Life
description: Conway's Game of Life plays out in the dot grid — dots live and die by their neighbours, producing organic oscillating patterns from simple rules

variations.name: default
variations.description: Each generation, every dot lives or dies based on its 8 neighbours following Conway's rules. Seeded with multiple blinker oscillators that interact across the toroidal grid.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the loader in pixels

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the loader in pixels

props.name: dotSize
props.description: Diameter of each dot in pixels

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of each generation step in seconds (lower = faster evolution)

props.name: gridSize
props.description: Number of dots per row and column (n × n grid)
